en: And that's it for this section.
In this section, you learned how you can
build truly autonomous agents by giving them
tools.
And you also learned how these tools work
and that it's not the large language model
that calls the tools, but that it's instead
just describing some intent to call a tool.
You also learned that the
definition of an agent is kind of blurry
because often people call
anything that uses AI and agent. And we also
did that here in this
research project where 2 of the 3 agents are
not autonomous. But that is fine because
ultimately you don't need to have a hard
differentiation between workflows and
agents. Ultimately, it's all about building
AI-powered applications that get a certain
job done, that automate a certain problem,
for example. And for that, you can use all
these tools and all these things you learned
in the previous section and in this section
here to build these workflows and these
tools and automations in exactly the way you
need.
